name: Bootstrap UI
description: Loads and configures the Bootstrap CSS/JS framework site-wide from an admin UI (CDN, local library, or Composer), with per-theme and per-path targeting, RTL support, version selection and per-file asset control.
library_dependencies: bootstrap (twbs/bootstrap front-end library, loaded via CDN or installed at /libraries/bootstrap)

suggests.drupal/mdbootstrap: Optional Material Design Bootstrap UI kit; when present its versions/releases become selectable in the same settings form via the bootstrap_ui_library_name hook.

project_description:
Integrates Bootstrap CSS framework along with a user interface for configuring and customize components, variables and plugins.

 Overview 
 Build fast, responsive Drupal sites with Bootstrap UI! 
 Powerful, extensible, and feature-packed frontend toolkit. Build and customize with Sass, utilize prebuilt grid system and components, and bring projects to life with powerful JavaScript plugins.

 Features 
 This module aims to provide various settings

 
 Support all stable versions 
 Load via CDN method 
 Load from local libraries (Support compiled & source files) 
 RTL support for all versions (Such as Persian, Farsi & Arabic languages) 
 Composer install (Separated module and library) 
 Restricts load by theme and URL 
 Ability to set minified or non-minified library 
 More possibilities in the future 
 
 Why Bootstrap UI ? 
 The difference between this module and other Bootstrap modules:

 
 Very light weight module with optimized programming structure for high performance 
 Active maintenance and update in sync with Bootstrap framework 
 Support all stable versions with CDN method, Composer and local library 
 The ability to limit loading based on themes and URLs 
 Right-to-left language support for all versions 
 Allows other modules to add custom components and UI kit versions such as Material Design Bootstrap. 
 
 Requirements 
 Download Bootstrap Library Desired Version from GitHub.
